verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly confirm one-click, free DNSSEC activation at Cloudflare Registrar, with a dedicated setup guide, and the Registrar API supports programmatic domain management. Since Cloudflare acts as both registrar and DNS provider, DS record handling at the registry is implicit in the one-click flow. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation of the DNSSEC signing/DS-record workflow specifically (community evidence focuses on pricing, nameservers, WHOIS, not DNSSEC).
